items.source: Base class for concrete, full-fledged BeanDefinition classes, factoring out common properties of GenericBeanDefinition, RootBeanDefinition, and ChildBeanDefinition.
items.translation: 具体、完整的BeanDefinition类的基类，提取了GenericBeanDefinition、RootBeanDefinition和ChildBeanDefinition的通用属性。

items.source: Extension of AttributeAccessorSupport, holding attributes as BeanMetadataAttribute objects in order to keep track of the definition source.
items.translation: `AttributeAccessorSupport` 的扩展，将属性作为 `BeanMetadataAttribute` 对象持有，以便跟踪定义来源。

items.source: Extended BeanDefinition interface that exposes AnnotationMetadata about its bean class - without requiring the class to be loaded yet.
items.translation: 扩展了BeanDefinition接口，该接口暴露了其 Bean 类的AnnotationMetadata信息——而无需先加载该类。

items.source: Extension of the GenericBeanDefinition class, adding support for annotation metadata exposed through the AnnotatedBeanDefinition interface.
items.translation: 扩展 `GenericBeanDefinition` 类，添加对通过 `AnnotatedBeanDefinition` 接口公开的注解元数据的支持。

items.source: Support class for AttributeAccessors, providing a base implementation of all methods.
items.translation: 支持类 `AttributeAccessors`，提供所有方法的基实现。

items.source: Default implementation of the TestContext interface.
items.translation: 默认实现TestContext接口。

items.source: Uses of AttributeAccessor in org.springframework.beans
items.translation: 在 `org.springframework.beans` 包中 `AttributeAccessor` 的用法

items.source: Uses of AttributeAccessor in org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation
items.translation: `org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation` 包中 `AttributeAccessor` 的用法

items.translation: `org.springframework.beans.factory.config` 中 `AttributeAccessor` 的用法

items.source: Uses of AttributeAccessor in org.springframework.beans.factory.support
items.translation: `org.springframework.beans.factory.support` 中 `AttributeAccessor` 的用法

items.translation: `org.springframework.context.annotation` 中 `AttributeAccessor` 的用法

items.source: Uses of AttributeAccessor in org.springframework.core
items.translation: `org.springframework.core` 中 `AttributeAccessor` 的用法

items.source: Uses of AttributeAccessor in org.springframework.test.context
items.translation: 在 `org.springframework.test.context` 中对 `AttributeAccessor` 接口的使用

items.source: Uses of AttributeAccessor in org.springframework.test.context.support
items.translation: `org.springframework.test.context.support` 中 `AttributeAccessor` 的用法

items.source: Extension of the GenericBeanDefinition class, based on an ASM ClassReader, with support for annotation metadata exposed through the AnnotatedBeanDefinition interface.
items.translation: 基于 ASM ClassReader 扩展的GenericBeanDefinition类，支持通过AnnotatedBeanDefinition接口暴露的注解元数据。

items.source: Classes supporting the org.springframework.beans.factory package.
items.translation: 支持org.springframework.beans.factory包的类。

items.source: This package contains the Spring TestContext Framework which provides annotation-driven unit and integration testing support that is agnostic of the actual testing framework in use.
items.translation: 该包包含Spring TestContext 框架，它提供与所使用的实际测试框架无关的基于注解的单元测试和集成测试支持。

items.source: Support classes for the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: 支持Spring TestContext Framework的类。

items.source: A root bean definition represents the merged bean definition at runtime that backs a specific bean in a Spring BeanFactory.
items.translation: 根 Bean 定义表示在 Spring BeanFactory 中支持特定 Bean 的运行时合并后的 Bean 定义。

items.source: TestContext encapsulates the context in which a test is executed, agnostic of the actual testing framework in use.
items.translation: TestContext 封装了测试执行的上下文，与实际使用的测试框架无关。

items.source: This package contains interfaces and classes for manipulating Java beans.
items.translation: 该包包含用于操作 Java 对象的接口和类。

items.source: Support package for annotation-driven bean configuration.
items.translation: 用于注解驱动的 Bean 配置的辅助包。

items.source: SPI interfaces and configuration-related convenience classes for bean factories.
items.translation: 用于 Bean 工厂的 SPI 接口和与配置相关的便捷类。

items.source:
Annotation support for the Application Context, including JSR-250 "common"
annotations, component-scanning, and Java-based metadata for creating
Spring-managed objects.
items.translation: 支持应用上下文的注解，包括 JSR-250“通用”注解、组件扫描以及用于创建 Spring 托管对象的基于 Java 的元数据。

items.source:
Provides basic classes for exception handling and version detection,
and other core helpers that are not specific to any part of the framework.
items.translation: 提供用于异常处理和版本检测的基础类，以及其他不针对框架任何特定部分的辅助核心工具。

items.source: Object to hold information and value for an individual bean property.
items.translation: 用于存储单个 Bean 属性的信息和值的对象。

items.source:
A BeanDefinition describes a bean instance, which has property values,
constructor argument values, and further information supplied by
concrete implementations.
items.translation: BeanDefinition 描述了一个 Bean 实例，该实例包含属性值、构造函数参数值以及由具体实现提供的其他信息。

items.source: Qualifier for resolving autowire candidates.
items.translation: 用于解析自动注入候选项的限定符。

items.source: Bean definition for beans which inherit settings from their parent.
items.translation: 继承自父类的 Bean 的 bean 定义。

items.source: GenericBeanDefinition is a one-stop shop for declarative bean definition purposes.
items.translation: GenericBeanDefinition 是声明式 Bean 定义的一站式解决方案。

items.source: Copy the attributes from the supplied AttributeAccessor to this accessor.
items.translation: 从提供的 AttributeAccessor 复制属性到此访问器。
